gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Expressive and wire-bent, Tektur opens every curve at the terminal, while Noto Sans Duployan stays a plain sans. Tektur is best at grabbing attention, the body at quiet, wide-mouthed legibility.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Distinctive straight away, Tektur has pipe-cleaner strokes and generously opened curves, beside the sans-serif Noto Sans Elymaic. And Tektur earns its keep big and short, where those quirks can be seen.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Expressive and a bit marker-drawn, Tektur takes the lead. Noto Sans Ethiopic, a plain sans with sturdy lowercase and far-hanging c terminals, carries paragraphs with a steady, modern pace.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans is modern and sans-serif, its lowercase rising near cap height and its c opening wide. And Gugi, with its constant-width sign-painter brush look, is the memorable part.
